scope: Two independent natural real-image continuous targets with five disjoint 200-row training cohorts and one shared 200-row evaluation cohort per dataset. This is developmental evidence, not untouched confirmation.

torchvision_gtsrb.target: inclusive official ROI box area divided by raw image area

torchvision_fgvc_aircraft.target: inclusive official aircraft bounding-box area divided by raw image area

candidate_roster_rule: Exact common intersection of the prior 16-backbone continuous panels and the outcome-free FUSED3 embedding registry, in the prior continuous-panel order.

selectors.save_rff_current: save_rffmean_k4 current_common32 from the same shared fold pass
selectors.bounded_2k: preserve broad winner then rank the broad top-10 pool by SAVE; with ten candidates the pool is complete

reference_heads.recipe: Unchanged continuous_residual_ranking three-fold training-only grid search and held-out R2
reference_heads.ranking_target: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen head families

outcome_policy: Panel implementation, cohorts, targets, candidate roster, and protocol are frozen before selector or reference-head outcomes are computed.
